system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi, yeah — I need a little rescue mission for an order.

My name’s Noah Patel. I placed an order with, uh, three home office items and some hiking stuff because I was gearing up to go hide out at my parents’ place in Seattle, work remotely, become one with nature, all that. And of course now my company has decided, “surprise, come back to the office soon,” which is just fantastic for my blood pressure.

So I’m trying to figure out if I can cancel part of the order — specifically the office items — and keep the hiking items. I honestly forgot exactly which office items I picked, which feels very on-brand for my current stress level.

If partial cancellation is possible, could you:
1. cancel the office items only,
2. tell me how much I’d get refunded total,
3. and send the refund back to my original payment method?

If partial cancellation isn’t possible, then please just change the shipping address to my NYC place instead, and I’ll deal with returns later like a responsible adult pretending to have it together.

I’m in New York, ZIP 10108.
noah_patel_6952

I can help with the address change fallback, but I can’t partially cancel only some items from a pending order. Cancellation is only available for the whole pending order.

To figure out the best next step, I need to identify which of your orders you mean. I found these orders on your account:
- #W1845024
- #W7043598
- #W6111398

Please tell me which order you want me to check. If you’re not sure, I can look up the details of one order at a time and help identify the one with the 3 home office items and hiking items.

Thanks — and wow, three orders. Past Noah really said “let’s make this a scavenger hunt.”

I’m not sure which one it is, so can you look them up one at a time and help me identify the order with the 3 home office items plus the hiking stuff?

Let’s start with #W1845024.
